blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Facial image watermarking can support traceability and certification in biometric pipelines, but provenance or manipulation detection alone does not guarantee reliable biometric identity. We introduce a watermark-preserving face evasion attack that targets this gap under a black-box watermarking setting, without access to the watermarking components. The proposed PGD-L_2 attack guides adversarial perturbations with spatial and spectral preservation terms to reduce face-recognition similarity while limiting pixel-level distortion and high-frequency changes that may interfere with hidden watermark cues. Evaluated on controlled facial images with two watermarking schemes, two face-recognition models, and two datasets, the attack achieves evasion rates above 92% at operational thresholds while preserving watermark recovery above 93% for StegaFormer and above 99.7% for FaceSigns, with visual quality above 47dB PSNR at epsilon_2=2.0. These results expose a structural gap in watermark-based facial certification: a face image can remain watermark-valid and visually faithful while becoming biometrically unreliable.
blocks.zh: 面部图像水印可以支持生物鉴别管道的可追踪性和认证,但仅凭来源或操纵检测并不能保证可靠的生物鉴别特征. 我们引入了防水标记的避水面攻击,在黑盒水标记设置下瞄准这个缺口,而不能进入水标记组件. 拟议的PGD-L_2攻击用空间和光谱保存术语指导对抗性扰动,以减少面部识别相似性,同时限制像素水平扭曲和高频变化,这些变化可能干扰隐藏的水印提示. 使用两个水印方案、两个面部识别模型和两个数据集对受控面部图像进行评估,在操作阈值时,攻击的逃逸率超过92%,同时将StegaFormer的水印回收率保持在93%以上,FaceSigns的回收率保持在99.7%以上,在epsilon_2=2.0时,视觉质量高于47dB PSNR。 这些结果暴露了基于水印的面部认证的结构性差距:面部图像可以保持水印和视觉上的忠实,同时变得生物特征不可靠.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Face images used in identity documents, border control, and remote verification systems must satisfy two distinct security requirements: they must be traceable to verify provenance, the issuing authority, or subsequent alteration, and they must remain biometrically reliable to support automated identity verification. Standards such as ICAO Doc 9303 [ 12 ] and ISO/IEC 39794-5:2019 [ 13 ] define technical requirements for face images in identity contexts, while regulatory and provenance frameworks, including the EU Artificial Intelligence Act [ 8 ] and C2PA-related initiatives [ 7 ] , reinforce the need for auditable visual evidence. Cryptographic signatures bind provenance to an exact byte sequence and do not survive the re-encoding and resizing typical of issuance pipelines, which is why provenance frameworks complement them with pixel-level soft bindings such as invisible watermarking [ 3 ] .
Recent neural watermarking methods improve the trade-off among imperceptibility, robustness, payload, and recovery accuracy [ 24 , 33 ] . In facial media, watermarking has also been extended to authentication and proactive forensics through semi-fragile designs [ 20 , 21 , 9 ] , tracing/manipulation-detection [ 16 , 27 ] , and robustness evaluation benchmarks [ 1 , 17 ] . However, these evaluations mainly assess watermark survival or manipulation detection, rather than verifying if a watermarked face remains reliable for biometric recognition.
blocks.zh:
身份证件、边境管制和远程核查制度中使用的面相图像必须满足两项不同的安全要求:必须能够追踪,以核实出处、签发当局或随后的更改,必须保持生物鉴别可靠,以支持自动身份核查。 国际民航组织第9303 [12]号文件和ISO/IEC 39794-5:2019 [13]号文件等标准界定了身份背景下对面相图像的技术要求,而监管和出处框架,包括欧盟人工智能法[8]和C2PA相关举措[7],则加强了对可审计视觉证据的需求. 密码学签名将出处绑定在一个精确的字节序列上,无法活过典型的发出管的再编码和再定型,这就是出处框架以像素级软绑来补充的原因,如隐形水印 [3].
最近的神经水标记方法改善了不易接受性、坚固性、有效载荷和回收精度之间的取舍[24、33]。 在面相介质中,也通过半脆弱设计[20,21,9],追踪/操纵-检测[16,27],以及稳健性评价基准[1,17],将水标记扩大到认证和主动法证. 然而,这些评价主要评估水印存活率或被操纵探测率,而不是核实有水印的面孔对生物识别是否仍然可靠.

blocks.en: A critical gap arises when watermark validity is implicitly treated as a proxy for image trustworthiness. A correctly recovered watermark can certify provenance, but it does not necessarily certify that the facial representation remains valid for biometric verification. Prior work has shown that facial biometric evidence can be deliberately degraded after generative editing as a privacy-preserving defense [ 25 ] . The failure mode studied here is different: an already watermarked facial image is adversarially modified so that the embedded watermark remains recoverable, while the face fails to match its own enrollment template under automated 1:1 verification. The perturbation drives the facial embedding away from its own reference, so that, to a human examiner, the image remains visually the same person. The resulting image is neither a watermark-removal case, in which the decoder fails, nor a watermark-forgery case, in which the decoder succeeds on an unwatermarked image. Instead, the decoder succeeds, and the watermark remains valid, but the face-recognition system rejects the same image.
blocks.zh: 当水印的有效性被隐含地视为图像可信赖性的代名词时,就会出现一个关键的空白. 正确取回的水印可以证明出处,但不一定证明面部表情仍然适用于生物鉴别验证. 先前的研究表明,面部生物鉴别证据在基因编辑后可被故意降解,作为保护隐私的辩护[25]. 这里研究的失败模式不同:一个已经有水印的面部图像被对抗性地修改,使得嵌入的水印仍然可以被取回,而面部则无法在自发的 1:1 验证下匹配自己的入门模板. 扰动使面部嵌入远离了自己的参考,这样,对于一个人类的检查者来说,图像保持了视觉上的同一个人. 由此而来的形象既不是解码器失败的水印去除的病例,也不是水印去除的病例,其中解码器在无水印图像上成功. 相反地,解码器成功,而水印依然有效,但面相识别系统拒绝相同的图像.

blocks.en: This distinction is important because semi-fragile facial watermarking schemes are typically designed to react to structural facial manipulations, such as face swapping or deepfake generation, rather than to small adversarial perturbations [ 21 ] . Such perturbations do not replace the face or visibly alter its semantic content. They introduce coordinated pixel-level changes that may appear, from the watermark decoder perspective, similar to benign image degradation. As a result, the image can still be certified as traceable while its biometric content is compromised.
blocks.zh: 这种区分很重要,因为半脆弱面部水分标记方案通常是为了对结构面部操纵,如面相交换或深假生成作出反应,而不是为了小的对抗性扰动[21]. 这种扰动不会取而代之,也不会明显地改变其语义内容。 它们引入了协调的像素级变化,从水印解码器的角度可能出现,类似于良性图像降解. 因此,该图像仍然可以认证为可追踪,同时其生物鉴别内容被破坏.

blocks.en: Existing research has studied adversarial attacks against face recognition and watermarking for facial media, but the inverse scenario considered here remains largely unexplored. Attacks such as FGSM [ 10 ] and PGD [ 19 ] , including face-specific physical and digital variants [ 6 , 23 ] , show that facial representations can be disrupted. Conversely, recent watermarking works have designed adversarial or dual-purpose watermarks for face swapping, deepfake detection, or identity protection [ 26 , 28 , 31 , 32 ] . In those cases, the watermarking process is modified, optimized, or exploited. Here, the adversary receives an already watermarked face image, treats the watermarking system as a black box, and optimizes a perturbation that evades face recognition while preserving the existing watermark.
blocks.zh: 现有的研究研究了对抗面部媒体识别和水分标记的对抗性攻击,但这里考虑的反面情景基本上仍未被探讨. FGSM[10]和PGD[19]等攻击,包括面相特异的物理和数字变体[6,23],表明面相表现可以被打乱. 与此相反,最近的水印工程设计了对抗性或双重用途的水印,用于面相交换、深假检测或身份保护[26、28、31、32]。 在这些情况下,水标记过程被修改、优化或利用。 在这里,对手收到一个已经被打上水印的面相图像,将水印系统当作黑匣子对待,并优化了在保留已存在的水印的同时逃避面相识别的扰动.

blocks.en: The present work formulates this inverse scenario as a security evaluation of watermarked biometric pipelines. The threat model reflects a realistic certification setting: in provenance and issuance pipelines the watermarking system belongs to the issuing authority, so a downstream adversary receives an already watermarked image and must treat it as black-box. The face-recognition model is instead assumed white-box, as a conservative worst-case on the biometric side—if the watermark–identity gap emerges against a fully known recognizer, the vulnerability is established, with transferability to unseen recognizers left to future work. Given a watermarked probe image, the attacker optimizes an L 2 L_{2} -bounded perturbation restricted to the facial region to reduce cosine similarity with the mated reference template. Because the watermark encoder, decoder, and message are unavailable to the attacker, as they remain under the issuing authority’s control, watermark preservation is enforced indirectly through spatial and spectral constraints. The spatial term limits pixel-level deviation from the watermarked image, while the spectral term penalizes high-frequency perturbation energy that may interfere with hidden watermark cues, in line with evidence that adversarial watermarking residuals emphasize high-frequency structures [ 28 ] and that watermark robustness can be affected by suppression of mid- and high-frequency patterns [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 目前的工作将这种反向情况描绘成对标有水的生物鉴别管道的安全评价。 威胁模式反映了一种现实的认证环境:在出处和发售管道中,水印系统属于发证当局,因此下游的对手收到已经有水印的图像,必须把它当作黑盒来对待. 脸部识别模式被假定为白盒,作为生物鉴别方面的保守最坏情况——如果水印识别差距出现在一个完全为人所熟知的识别者身上,那么脆弱性就已经确立,可转移给看不见的识别者留待未来工作。 鉴于一个有水印的探针图像,攻击者优化了L 2 L_{2} - 被限制在面部区域的扰动,以减少与相配的参考模板相近的余弦. 由于攻击者无法获得水印编码器、解码器和信件,因为水印仍由发证当局控制,因此通过空间和光谱限制间接实施水印保存。 空间名词限制像素水平偏离有水标记的图像,而光谱名词则惩罚可能干扰隐藏有水标记提示的高频扰动能,这符合对抗性水标记残留强调高频结构的证据[28],而有水标记坚固性会受压制中高频模式的影响[17].

blocks.en: The paper makes three contributions. First, it formulates watermark-preserving biometric evasion as a security task, with a threat model granting black-box watermark access and white-box recognizer access. Second, it introduces a PGD- L 2 L_{2} attack with spatial and spectral preservation that requires no access to the watermark encoder, decoder, or embedded message. Third, it evaluates the attack across two watermark-capacity regimes, represented by FaceSigns [ 21 ] and StegaFormer [ 29 ] , on two controlled face datasets and two face-recognition models. The results show that watermark validity and biometric identity are independent properties: a face image can remain traceable while becoming unreliable for automated verification.
blocks.zh: 该文件提出了三项意见。 首先,它将保留水印生物识别逃生作为一项安全任务,威胁模式允许黑箱水印进入和白箱识别器进入。 其次,它引入了PGD-L 2 L_{2} 使用空间和光谱保护的攻击,不需要访问水印编码器,解码器或嵌入式消息. 第三,它评价了以FaceSigns [21]和StegaFormer [29]为代表的两个水印容量系统,在两个可控面相数据集和两个面相识别模型上的攻击. 结果显示,水印的有效性和生物识别特征是独立的属性:面相图像可以保持可追踪性,而对于自动化验证则变得不可靠.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Digital watermarking embeds hidden information in images for ownership verification, provenance tracking, and authentication. Neural methods such as HiDDeN [ 33 ] , StegaStamp [ 24 ] , and MBRS [ 14 ] formulate watermarking as an end-to-end encoder–decoder problem that jointly optimizes imperceptibility, robustness, payload capacity, and message recovery. More recent high-capacity methods, including StegaFormer [ 29 ] , further increase payload density while maintaining high recovery and visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: 数字水印将隐藏信息嵌入图像,用于所有权验证,出处跟踪和认证. HIDDEN [33],StegaStamp [24]等神经方法,以及MBRS [14] 将水标记作为端到端编码器-解码器问题,共同优化了不透视性,稳健性,有效载荷容量,以及信息恢复. 更近期的高功率方法,包括StegaFormer [29],进一步提高了有效载荷密度,同时保持了高回收率和视觉忠诚.

blocks.en: In facial media, watermarking has been adapted to authentication and proactive forensics. FaceSigns [ 21 ] and related semi-fragile schemes [ 20 ] preserve the watermark under benign transformations while reacting to facial manipulations. SepMark [ 27 ] and BiFPro [ 16 ] separate tracing and manipulation detection through watermark components with different robustness profiles, while benchmarks such as WAVES [ 1 ] and W-Bench [ 17 ] evaluate watermark survival under distortions, regeneration, editing, and adversarial attacks. However, these evaluations mainly assess whether the watermark can still be detected or decoded. They do not test whether the same watermarked image remains reliable for biometric recognition.
blocks.zh: 在面部媒体中,水印被调整为认证和主动法证. FaceSigns [21] 及相关的半脆弱方案 [20] 在对面部操纵的反应的同时,在良性转化下保留了水印. SepMark [27]和BiFPro [16] 通过具有不同强性特征的水印组件分别进行追踪和操纵检测,而WAVES [1]和W-Bench [17]等基准则在扭曲,再生,编辑和对抗攻击下评价水印存活情况. 然而,这些评价主要评估水印是否可以被检测出或解码. 它们不测试同一水印图像是否仍然可靠,以进行生物鉴别。

blocks.en: Adversarial attacks against face recognition provide the complementary perspective. General attacks such as FGSM [ 10 ] and PGD [ 19 ] showed that small norm-bounded perturbations can alter deep-network decisions, while face-specific studies demonstrated this vulnerability in physical and digital verification settings [ 6 , 23 ] . Recent biometric-defense methods further show that adversarial perturbations can deliberately degrade identity representations after generative editing [ 25 ] . These works demonstrate that face representations can be selectively disrupted, but they do not consider already-watermarked facial images or measure whether watermark recovery survives the attack.
blocks.zh: 对脸部识别的负面攻击提供了补充视角。 诸如密克罗尼西亚[10]和PGD[19]等一般性攻击表明,受规范约束的小型扰动可以改变深网络的决定,而针对面的研究表明,在物理和数字核查环境中这种脆弱性[6,23]。 近期的生物鉴别防御方法进一步表明,对抗性扰动可以在基因编辑后故意降低身份表达. [25]. 这些作品表明面部表情可以有选择地被打乱,但并不考虑已经有水印的面部相片,也不考虑水印恢复是否在被攻击后幸存.

blocks.en:
Several works combine watermarking and adversarial signals for active protection against facial manipulation. CMUA-Watermark [ 11 ] , TAFIM [ 2 ] , Dual Defense [ 32 ] , and AdvMark [ 26 ] proactively inject a watermark-like or adversarial signal at embedding time, so that a later DeepFake generation, face swap, or forensic-detection step is disrupted while some traceability is preserved. Their goal is manipulation prevention by design, not biometric verification under an already watermarked probe.
The closest works that connect watermarking with face recognition [ 28 ] jointly optimize an input perturbation and a watermark message so that a face is correctly recognized before watermarking but fails after the watermark encoder is applied. DIP-Watermark [ 31 ] designs an identity-specific adversarial watermark that degrades unauthorized face recognition while remaining extractable for authorized verification. Both expose the coupling between watermark signals and biometric recognition, but they control the watermarking process itself, by optimizing the message, adapting the encoder, or designing the watermark as an adversarial signal. The setting studied in this paper is inverse and acts at attack time: the adversary receives an already watermarked face image, has no access to the encoder, decoder, or message, and perturbs it so that face recognition fails while the existing watermark remains valid, as in an issuance pipeline, where an authority-watermarked image can be altered downstream to still pass provenance checks while no longer matching its holder, yielding a document that is certified yet biometrically unreliable.
blocks.zh:
一些作品将水印和对抗信号结合起来,积极防面部被操纵. CMUA-Watermark [11], TAFIM [2], Duble Defense [32],和AdvMark [26] 在嵌入时主动地注入了类似水印或对抗性的信号,从而在保留一些可追溯性的同时打乱了后期的"深假"生成,相换,或法证检测步骤. 他们的目标是通过设计来防止操纵,而不是在已经标有水印的探测器下进行生物鉴别核查。
连接水印与面相识别的最相近作品[28]联合优化了输入扰动和水印消息,使面相在水印被识别前正确识别,但在水印编码器被应用后失败. DIP-Watermark [31] 设计出一种针对特定身份的对抗性水印,可以降解未经授权的面部识别,同时仍可被提取用于授权的核查. 两者都暴露出水印信号和生物识别的结合,但他们通过优化信息,调整编码器,或者设计水印作为对抗信号来控制水印过程本身. 本文所研究的设定是反向的,在攻击时有行为:对手收到已经打上水印的面相图像,无法取用编码器,解码器或信息,并扰动它,以致在现有的水印仍然有效时,面相识别失败,如在发水管中,当局打出水印的图像可以在下游被改变,仍能通过出处检查而不再与持有者匹配,从而产生一个经过认证但生物特征不可靠的文件.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 4 实验议定书

blocks.en: The experimental evaluation is designed to assess whether a watermarked facial image can remain traceable while becoming unreliable for biometric verification. Experiments are conducted on two controlled frontal face datasets representative of identity-document-like acquisition conditions: the Chicago Face Database (CFD) [ 18 ] and FaceLab London [ 4 ] . We attack all available probe images in the selected subsets, namely 831 images from CFD and 102 images from FaceLab London. Mated template–probe pairs are built from identities with at least two samples, resulting in 158 identities from CFD and 102 identities from FaceLab London. In each pair, the template and probe share the same identity and differ mainly in facial expression, with changes in smile being the dominant variation. Only the probe image is watermarked and attacked, while the template image remains unchanged.
blocks.zh: 实验性评价旨在评估有水印的面部图像能否保持可追踪性,同时变得不可靠,无法进行生物鉴别验证. 在代表身份文件类获取条件的两个可控面相数据集上进行实验:芝加哥面相数据库[18]和FaceLab London [4]. 我们攻击选定子集中所有可用的探测图像,即CFD的831个图像和FaceLab London的102个图像. 成型模板 - 探测对从至少两个样本的身份中构建出来,产生来自CFD的158个身份和来自FaceLab London的102个身份. 每对中,模板和探测器都具有相同的特征,主要在面部表情上有所不同,而微笑的变化是主导变异. 只有探测器图像有水印并被攻击,而模板图像保持不变.

blocks.en: The biometric verification stage is evaluated using two white-box face recognition models: ArcFace with a ResNet-100 backbone [ 5 ] and FaceNet based on InceptionResnetV1 pretrained on VGGFace2 [ 22 ] . The use of two architectures allows us to evaluate whether the attack behavior remains consistent across different embedding models. Faces and landmarks are detected with MTCNN [ 30 ] , and the detected landmarks are used for face alignment before feature extraction. Aligned faces are resized to 160 × 160 160\times 160 for FaceNet and 112 × 112 112\times 112 for ArcFace. The perturbation 𝜹 \bm{\delta} is optimized in the image domain. Gradients are propagated through the differentiable preprocessing operations used by the recognition model, while the detected facial region and the corresponding mask 𝐌 \mathbf{M} are kept fixed during each attack.

blocks.en: Before watermark embedding, all probe images are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels. Two watermarking architectures are considered to cover different payload regimes. FaceSigns [ 21 ] is used as a low-capacity facial watermarking model embedding 128-bit binary messages, using the authors’ released model trained on CelebA. StegaFormer [ 29 ] is used as a high-capacity transformer-based watermarking architecture; in our experiments, it is trained at 1 bpp on CelebA-HQ [ 15 ] with random binary messages. During evaluation, a unique binary message is generated for each identity and embedded consistently in the corresponding probe images.

blocks.en: The experimental evaluation is organized around three complementary criteria: biometric evasion, measured by ASR at FAR = 1 % =1\% and FAR = 0.1 % =0.1\% ; visual fidelity, measured by PSNR; and watermark recovery, measured by BAR. We first report the pre-attack watermarking quality on the selected evaluation images, then analyze the baseline PGD- L 2 L_{2} attack and finally evaluate the proposed spatial–spectral attack. Before applying adversarial perturbations, both watermarking models achieve highly reliable message recovery across the selected datasets, albeit in substantially different visual-fidelity regimes. StegaFormer achieves BAR values between 99.58 % 99.58\% and 99.98 % 99.98\% , with PSNR between 56.97 56.97 and 59.47 59.47 dB. FaceSigns achieves BAR values between 99.91 % 99.91\% and 99.99 % 99.99\% , with PSNR between 31.60 31.60 and 32.62 32.62 dB. These values indicate that both watermarking models provide a stable traceability signal before the attack. The following analyses, therefore, measure the effect of adversarial perturbations on already valid watermarked probes.

FaceSigns的BAR值在99.91% 99.91%和99.99% 99.99%之间,PSNR值在31.60 31.60和32.62 32.62 dB之间. 这些数值表明两种水印模型在攻击前都提供了稳定的可追踪信号. 因此,以下分析衡量对抗性扰动对已经有效的水印探测器的影响。

Table 1 reports the results of the baseline PGD- L 2 L_{2} attack on CFD and FaceLab London. The baseline optimizes only the adversarial verification loss and therefore provides the reference condition for assessing whether watermark recovery can survive a purely biometric evasion objective. Across all datasets, recognition models, and watermarking schemes, the attack is highly effective against face verification: at ε 2 = 2.0 \varepsilon_{2}=2.0 , ASR 0.1 exceeds 96 % 96\% in all configurations. This confirms that watermark embedding alone does not prevent adversarial evasion of the downstream face-recognition system.
The impact on watermark recovery depends strongly on the watermarking architecture. For FaceSigns, BAR remains above 99.7 % 99.7\% in all baseline configurations, even at the largest perturbation budgets. A standard adversarial perturbation restricted to the facial region is therefore sufficient to produce a probe that is rejected by the biometric system while remaining almost perfectly traceable. This result exposes the watermark–identity gap already under a conventional biometric attack, particularly for low-capacity facial watermarking.

对水印恢复的影响在很大程度上取决于水印建筑. 就FaceSigns而言,在所有基线配置中,BAR仍然高于99.7% 99.7%,即使是最大的扰动预算。 因此,限制在面部区域的标准对抗性扰动足以产生被生物鉴别系统所拒绝的探测器,同时几乎完全可以追踪。 这一结果暴露出在常规生物鉴别攻击下已经存在的水印-身份差距,特别是在低容量面部水印方面。

blocks.en: StegaFormer is more sensitive to the same perturbations. On CFD, BAR decreases to 89.49 89.49 – 87.01 % 87.01\% for ε 2 ≥ 2.0 \varepsilon_{2}\geq 2.0 when attacking ArcFace, while on FaceLab London it remains above 93 % 93\% for both recognition models. This behavior is consistent with the higher embedding density of the 1 bpp configuration, where more information is distributed across the image and message recovery becomes more sensitive to pixel-level adversarial changes. Nevertheless, the watermark is not destroyed: BAR remains far above random chance even in the most degraded cases. These baseline results motivate the preservation terms introduced in Sec. 3.3 , whose purpose is not to make evasion possible, but to improve watermark recovery while maintaining high attack success.

Table 2 reports the proposed PGD- L 2 L_{2} attack with spatial-only preservation ( λ spa = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{spa}}=1 , λ spe = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{spe}}=0 ) and spatial–spectral preservation ( λ spa = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{spa}}=1 , λ spe = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{spe}}=1 ). All configurations use λ adv = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{adv}}=1 . For FaceSigns, the attack still preserves the watermark almost perfectly across all settings. BAR remains above 99.7 % 99.7\% for all configurations, while ASR 0.1 reaches 100 % 100\% for ε 2 ≥ 2.0 \varepsilon_{2}\geq 2.0 . However, incorporating the spectral term at higher budgets ( ε 2 ≥ 2.0 \varepsilon_{2}\geq 2.0 ) causes a slight degradation in BAR. Because FaceSigns introduces visible artifacts in low and mid-frequencies, the spectral constraint allows the adversarial perturbation to alter these specific frequency bands, marginally impacting watermark extraction (see visual perturbations in Figure 3 ).
StegaFormer represents a more challenging setting. Compared with the baseline, the proposed preservation terms substantially improve BAR while maintaining high evasion rates. On CFD at ε 2 = 2.0 \varepsilon_{2}=2.0 , BAR increases from 89.49 % 89.49\% to 93.62 % 93.62\% with spatial preservation and to 94.53 % 94.53\% with spatial–spectral preservation when attacking ArcFace. For FaceNet, the corresponding increase is from 92.53 % 92.53\% to 97.07 % 97.07\% and 97.55 % 97.55\% . A similar trend is observed on FaceLab London, where BAR reaches 98.70 98.70 – 98.75 % 98.75\% at the same perturbation budget. These results show that the proposed regularization is most useful for high-capacity and high imperceptibility watermarking, where the embedded message is more sensitive to adversarial pixel-level changes. The spectral term provides a consistent, yet moderate, additional gain, especially at larger perturbation budgets. At ε 2 = 3.0 \varepsilon_{2}=3.0 on CFD, spatial–spectral preservation improves BAR from 92.91 % 92.91\% to 93.99 % 93.99\% for ArcFace and from 95.38 % 95.38\% to 96.39 % 96.39\% for FaceNet. This suggests that most of the preservation effect is already captured by the spatial term, while the spectral term further regularizes the perturbation when the attack has more energy to distribute. Importantly, the improved watermark recovery does not substantially reduce the effectiveness of attacks. At ε 2 = 2.0 \varepsilon_{2}=2.0 , the proposed attack reaches ASR 0.1 ≥ 96.2 % {}_{0.1}\geq 96.2\% on CFD for ArcFace and 100 % 100\% for FaceNet, while all FaceLab London configurations reach 100 % 100\% ASR 0.1 . Thus, the proposed objective simultaneously satisfies the three target conditions: high biometric evasion, high watermark recovery, and high visual fidelity. Figure 2 summarizes this trade-off by showing that the proposed attack improve ASR and BAR with respect to the baselines.

blocks.en: The practical implication is that watermark validity alone is insufficient to certify biometric reliability. The recovered BAR after the proposed attack lies within, and in several cases above, the recovery levels that FaceSigns was designed to tolerate under benign image operations such as compression and social-media filtering [ 21 ] . In particular, FaceSigns remains above 99.7 % 99.7\% BAR under all tested adversarial configurations, which is comparable to or higher than the recovery reported for standard benign transformations in its original evaluation. Similarly, StegaFormer can retain near-unperturbed recovery on FaceLab London at ε 2 = 1.0 \varepsilon_{2}=1.0 , reaching 99.32 % 99.32\% and 99.50 % 99.50\% for ArcFace/Facenet, respectively, while already achieving high biometric evasion ( 82.4 % 82.4\% and 98 % 98\% ). A verifier relying only on successful message recovery would therefore have no direct evidence that the biometric content has been adversarially degraded.

blocks.en: The two watermarking schemes expose complementary aspects of the vulnerability. For FaceSigns, the gap already appears under the baseline PGD attack. The low-capacity watermark remains almost perfectly recoverable even without explicit preservation terms. For StegaFormer, the higher payload density makes recovery more sensitive to adversarial perturbations, and the proposed spatial–spectral regularization improves BAR by several percentage points while maintaining comparable evasion rates. In both cases, the central conclusion is the same: provenance and identity are independent properties of a facial image, and a valid watermark should not be treated as sufficient evidence that the image remains reliable for face recognition.
blocks.zh: 这两个水分标记计划暴露出脆弱性的互补方面。 对于FaceSigns,该缺口已经出现在基线PGD攻击下. 低容量水印即使没有明确的保存条件,仍然几乎完全可以收回。 对于StegaFormer来说,更高的有效载荷密度使得回收对对抗性扰动更为敏感,拟议的空间-光谱规范在保持可比较的逃逸率的同时提高了几个百分点。 在这两种情况下,中心结论都是一样的:出处和身份是一面相像的独立属性,有效的水印不应被视作图像对于面相识别仍然可靠的充分证据.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: This work introduced a watermark-preserving face evasion attack that exposes a structural gap in watermark-based facial certification. The proposed PGD- L 2 L_{2} attack uses spatial and spectral preservation terms to generate adversarial probes that remain traceable through their hidden watermark, while becoming unreliable for face verification. Across two controlled face datasets, two watermarking architectures, and two face recognition models, the attack achieves high evasion rates at operational thresholds while preserving high watermark recovery and visual quality. The results show that this gap depends on the watermarking regime. For FaceSigns, the watermark remains almost perfectly recoverable even under a standard PGD attack, showing that the vulnerability can already emerge without explicit preservation terms. For StegaFormer, the higher payload density makes recovery more sensitive to adversarial perturbations, but the proposed spatial–spectral regularization substantially improves BAR while maintaining high attack success. In both cases, successful watermark recovery does not imply that the image remains biometrically reliable. The evaluated watermarking models were not designed to resist this threat; the results expose a limitation of certification pipelines that treat watermark validity as a proxy for biometric trustworthiness. The current attack assumes white-box access to the face recognition model, and transferability to unseen models remains an important direction for future work. From a defensive perspective, these findings motivate certification pipelines that treat watermark validity and biometric reliability as complementary security properties rather than interchangeable indicators of trustworthiness. Developing and evaluating integrated defenses capable of jointly assessing provenance preservation and biometric consistency under adversarial conditions remains an important direction for future research. The adversarial perturbation is designed to remain below semi-fragile detection thresholds, highlighting the need to further investigate whether defenses that rely solely on watermark fragility are sufficient against this class of attacks. More broadly, this work provides evidence that provenance and identity are independent properties of a facial image, and that systems designed to guarantee one do not automatically guarantee the other.
blocks.zh: 这部作品引入了"防水标记"的避相相攻击,暴露出以"水标记"为基础的面部认证存在结构性漏洞. 拟议的PGD-L2 L_{2}攻击使用空间和光谱保存术语来产生对抗性探测器,这些探测器通过隐藏的水印仍然可以追踪,而对于面相验证则变得不可靠. 通过两个可控面相数据集,两个水印架构,以及两个面相识别模型,攻击在操作阈值上实现了高逃取率,同时保持了高水印恢复和视觉质量. 结果显示,这一差距取决于水标记制度。 就FaceSigns而言,即使在标准的PGD攻击下,水印也几乎完全可以恢复,这表明在没有明确的保存条件的情况下,脆弱性可能已经出现. 对于StegaFormer来说,较高的有效载荷密度使回收对对抗性扰动更加敏感,但拟议的空间-光谱规范在保持高攻击成功的同时大大改进了BAR。 在这两种情况下,成功取回水印并不意味着图像在生物鉴别学上仍然可靠。 评估的水标记模型不是用来抵御这种威胁的;结果暴露出将水标记有效性作为生物鉴别可信赖性的代名词的认证管道有限。 当前的攻击假设白盒进入面相识别模型,可转移到看不见模型仍然是未来工作的一个重要方向. 从防守的角度来看,这些结论促使认证管道将水印有效性和生物鉴别可靠性视为补充性安全属性,而不是可互换的可信赖性指标。 制定和评价能够联合评估原产地保全和对抗条件下生物鉴别一致性的综合防御,仍然是今后研究的一个重要方向。 对抗性扰动被设计为保持在半脆弱探测阈值以下,突出表明需要进一步调查仅仅依靠水印脆弱性的防御是否足以抵挡这一类攻击. 更广义地说,本作提供了证据,证明出处和身份是面相图像的独立属性,而旨在保证一个的系统并不自动保证另一个.
